long_biography.plain_text:
Raised in Portsmouth, Scott left university for construction after working as a nightclub doorman. A £5,000 inheritance from his grandmother financed his first renovation at 18. That project seeded a property career that expanded into hundreds of homes and a group of hotels. The 2008 crash erased the debt-backed portfolio, forcing him back onto building sites before he rebuilt.

Scott founded REL Capital to invest in businesses needing restructuring. He combined his property experience with acquisitions in hospitality, recruitment and transport. The group's ownership model keeps management teams involved while supplying capital and restructuring support. REL Capital has also developed insolvency litigation funding in Britain and turnaround investments in South Florida.
